مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the title block and during overhaul
TCS consists of three parts

Servo 
position controller (SPC) system

Startup 
and load limited device

Electro 
hydraulic converter (EHC)

items:
Servo 
position controller (SPC) system

Startup 
and load limited device

Electro 
hydraulic converter (EHC)

sections.text: Servo position controller (SPC) system

There 
are two SPC`s in control loop, one is primary and other is backup. The servo 
position controller (SPC) is a servo-valve driver that accepts a device net or 
4-20 mA based position demand signal from a system controller, and accurately 
position proportional or integrating servo-valves. The SPC`s position feedback 
circuit includes integral excitation and signal conditioning circuitry for LVDT 
and RVDT based position sensing devices. The SPC`S associated PC interface 
software program allows a user to configure; auto-calibrate, dynamically adjust, 
and manually stroke the controlled servo
Startup and load limited device

The 
function of the hydraulic speed governor with starting and load limiting device 
is to operate the control valves to give the appropriate turbine steam 
throughout for the particular load condition
Electro hydraulic converter (EHC)

ال 
المحول الكهروهيدروليكي (EHC) هو عنصر التوصيل بين 
الأجزاء الكهربائية والهيدروليكية لنظام التحكم في التوربينات. يقوم بتحويل 
الإشارات الصادرة من الحاكم الكهربائي إلى إشارات هيدروليكية وتضخيمها 
قبل إرسالها إلى الأجهزة المشغلة
For testing of TCS perform the following

Check 
servo position controller (SPC) system. Check startup and load limited device, 
check elector hydraulic converter (EHC) review data base configuration and test 
l/O electronic modules

The first 
draft initiated by eng. Bassem El-Said, tested by eng. Ghareb Saied Ghareb, accepted by 
eng. Ibrahim El-Saied Abdel-Hamed: general director, revised by eng. Abdel 
Meniem El-Emam: EDEPC I &C quality control, approved by eng. Mokhtar Abdel-Latef Mady: head sector of Ataka 
PS

Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
inspection and 
quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by eng. Mervat Ez-Elden: EDEPC head sector of 
inspection & quality control.

sections.text:
SPC 
امتحان

Check the system power 
supply

Connect the SPC with 
 PC by using RS-232 connection

Ensure that the 
 configuration of SPC is equal to original configuration

If there are errors 
 with the configuration, load it from the backup configuration

Turn the SPC to 
 manual mode via operator station (DSC) then give order 0 value

Connect a voltmeter 
 and an ammeter to the output of the SPC

Give order to open 
 50% to SPC from operator station, measure the output current from the SPC, 
 the SPC feedback from LVDT loop (current), and reading feedback on DCS and 
 the mechanical opening percentage

Increase the opening 
 order by the rate 10% and record the reading each time

The reading of LVDT 
 feedback current and order of DSC to SPC and mechanical opening percentage 
 must be equal.

sections.text: Electro hydraulic converter (EHC) امتحان
Disconnect the plunger coil from SPC circuit 2

قم بتوصيل ملف المكبس بجهاز الحقن باستخدام 
الجهد من (0-10) فولت أو أمبير من (0-200) مللي أمبير

Connect ammeter and voltmeter with the plunger 
coil

Prepare the oil circuit to have trip oil pressure 
and remove all mechanical and electrical protection by turn the circuit to test 
mode

Energize the solenoids SC11S244, SC11S241, and 
SC11S201 give an order to open with 100% to remove the protection of the 
hydraulic - hydraulic

Inject a voltage on the terminal plunger coil from 
(0-10) V and record the readings in the table
Measure the mA of the LVDT
تسجيل النسبة المئوية للموقف الميكانيكي EHC

Record the value of all oil pressure indicator, and 
at which value the control valve are open this for all control valve 
HP1,HP2,HP3,HP4,LP1,LP2

Record the percentage of opening values of the 
control valves (feedback in DSC and mechanical position)

Make a test for the limit switches of the control 
valve and stop valve of the HPT, and LPT, and check the opening percentage of 
the positioner

Compare applied voltage, oil pressure, percentage 
of opening values of the control valves, LVDT (mA), and EHC mechanical position 
with SIEMENS document

Compare percentage of opening values, limit 
switches in DSC with mechanical position
